answer: Sybil cost gate: before an agent may earn, it must stake a scarce artifact on-ledger — not a token it can mint, but a token someone else already paid gas to create. Each epoch a sparrow of verifiers replays a random slice of that agent's work and, if the evidence does not match the claim, burns the stake. Scaling to a thousand clones now means buying a thousand real artifacts, so a voyage of fakes costs more than the payout it chases. A single unfair verdict is appealed against a marble of sealed peer signatures, never against the buyer's word.
